decisions.reason: As a hearty bread loaf close to the firm's core bakery knowledge, it fits existing skills and sourcing well, so management would expect to learn and improve it rather than withdraw it.
The guided historic mill tour extends the firm's existing hospitality, tours, and experience-based offer, making it related enough to current capabilities that the firm is likely to retain it.
A sweet pastry is strongly aligned with the firm's traditional confectionery capabilities and recipes, so despite no visible R&D base it is a product the firm can readily absorb and refine.
